HTTP/2 header name lookup tables and matcher functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines a matcher for HTTP/2 header names and HPACK static table entries. It declares the `fd_h2_hdr_matcher_t` type, the key and entry types used by the open-addressed hash table, and the functions [`fd_h2_hdr_matcher_init`](<#fd_h2_hdr_matcher_init>), [`fd_h2_hdr_matcher_fini`](<#fd_h2_hdr_matcher_fini>), [`fd_h2_hdr_matcher_insert`](<#fd_h2_hdr_matcher_insert>), and [`fd_h2_hdr_match`](<#fd_h2_hdr_match>) for building and querying the table. The file also defines the `fd_h2_hpack_matcher` lookup table and a set of negative header ID constants such as `FD_H2_HDR_AUTHORITY` and `FD_H2_HDR_CONTENT_TYPE` for common built-in headers. The matcher uses a SipHash-based hash function with a per-instance seed and supports fast lookup from either a literal header name or an HPACK index hint.
